anna: Hi all, I'm Anna (anna@contractor.redwood). I accepted the Okta invite but my Google alias (anna@redwoodapp.com) isn't linked so I can't access the onboarding Drive. 1Password shows "no seat" and SMS MFA isn't coming through (roaming). Can someone give me temp Drive + 1Password access and an MFA workaround?

sam-it: Welcome Anna! Can you DM a personal email for a temp Drive share? We can issue a 1Password guest link and open a ticket for the seat. For MFA, we can enable TOTP while SMS is unreliable.

anna: DM'd anna.personal@gmail.com. TOTP works for me.

provision-bot: INC-2701 created by sam-it: "Contractor alias mapping + 1Password seat" P2.

devex: Sending a 24h 1Password guest vault link in DM now (please don't store long-term secrets). Also sharing onboarding Drive to anna.personal@gmail.com.

sam-it: Drive shared and added you to contractors-temp group. Infra flagged that the external domain mapping for contractor.redwood -> redwoodapp.com is missing.

infra-maya: I'm on it 12 SCIM rule update planned, ETA 4-6 hours, will trigger user sync after change.

anna: I can access the Drive and guest 1Password, thanks! I'll DM my GitHub handle and public SSH key for repo access.

sam-it: Got the key, will add you to the contractors team once alias sync completes. For now keep using the guest vault + TOTP.

provision-bot: INC-2701 status updated 12 infra-maya assigned; 1Password seat requested from licensing."
